A.claim: Sharp curvature separation. Every hyperbolic Beal signature has |chi| >= 1/12 with equality exactly at permutations of (3,3,4), while every one of the ten known primitive hyperbolic solutions has |chi| <= 1/18. Hence Beal is equivalent to: no primitive solution has |chi| >= 1/12. This explains the exponent-2 phenomenon quantitatively - an exponent

B.claim: At p=3: if 3 divides none of A,B,C and 3 divides both x and y, then C^z = 2 or 7 mod 9, and consequently 3 does not divide z. Elementary (the cubes among units mod 9 are exactly {1,8}), independent of FLT3.
